title: How Many Pawns to BEAT Martin?
summary: Tony starts with only a king and 1 pawn vs Martin's full army, and adds a whole ROW of pawns each game. Game 1 (K+1 pawn) is lost immediately; game 2 with a full extra row (9 pawns) he wins, promoting all his surviving pawns before mating.
rules: White: king + pawns only; Black (Martin): full army.
After each loss add a full row (8) of pawns.
